bibliographic.title: The Epic of the Mountaincutter
bibliographic.author: xegubua
bibliographic.description:
Once a tale forgotten, now retold and given into your hands.

You come from Barangay Manalo to see two warriors duke it out, and to tell the tale to your Datu. As accurate as you can get it.

You have no idea what story you will tell....

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Inspired by Filipino Myth, journalism, and faux Twitter stans. Around 30 minutes of gameplay, depending on reading speed it could be faster or slower.

Art by Frederic Edwin Church, taken from the Smithsonian Institute
Amateurishly made  for the (No) Dialogue Game Jam 2026

Feedback is appreciated!
